dimensions.label: Actor type
dimensions.description: Who performs the flow: a person in the browser preview, or an agent through MCP.

dimensions.label: Role
dimensions.description: What the actor is responsible for in the project.

dimensions.label: Experience
dimensions.description: How familiar the actor is with Artisign.

dimensions.label: Project size
dimensions.description: How many screens and use cases the project holds. Decides whether lists need filters and paging.

values.label: Large (hundreds of screens or thousands of use cases)

personas.name: Dana
personas.description: Reviews and steers the design in the browser preview while agents write the screens.
goals: See every change the agent makes as it happens
Comment on a node instead of describing it in chat
Approve one direction out of several options

personas.name: Pablo
personas.description: Owns the spec of a large product and maintains use cases before they become tickets.
goals: Find one use case among thousands in seconds
Spot persona groups without a variant

personas.name: Sol
personas.description: Builds a product alone with AI tools. Installs Artisign for the first time and has no design system yet.
goals: Get from install to a first screen in minutes
Never edit a config file by hand

personas.name: Dex
personas.description: An AI agent that writes tokens, components and screens through the MCP tools and checks every write with a screenshot.
goals: Reuse the design system instead of inline values
Spend as few tokens as possible per task

personas.name: Coda
personas.description: An AI agent that implements screens in a codebase from the design and the use cases. Reads, never writes the design.
goals: Get a screen or use case with everything attached in one call
Be told when a mapping is stale
